From \(b+c=148\), \(76\le c\le 94\) gives:
\[
76\le 148-b\le 94 \implies 54\le b\le 72.
\]
Exclude \(b=54\) because then \(c=94\), making 94 repeat. Exclude \(b=72\) because then \(c=76\), making 76 appear three times. Thus:
\[
b\in\{55,56,\ldots,71\},
\]
which has \(71-55+1=17\) possibilities.

\boxed{17}
